transcript.content: Hello, welcome. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well, I suppose things just got a bit out of hand lately. 

I took on a project for the historical society. I guess I just... I acted like I could run the whole fundraiser myself. I started doing all these quilt designs, and... calling volunteers, making schedules. Just promising deadlines I couldn't possibly meet. 

So... that's why I'm here, I guess.
Have you noticed that you're not enjoying activities as much as you used to, or that things you once found pleasurable don't seem to interest you anymore?

I suppose... yes. I usually like checking on my garden, or... working on my own quilt entries. But lately... I don't know. I just look at the fabric, or the seed catalogs, and... I don't really feel much at all. Just... nothing, I guess.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless most days lately?
Um... no. I don't think so. I wouldn't say I feel sad, really. Just... what I said before. Just not feeling much of anything.
Have you noticed that you've been feeling particularly tired or lacking energy lately, even when you haven't been doing much?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I haven't been doing much, so... I don't think I feel tired. Just... sitting around, mostly.
Have you noticed that you're not responding to things that used to bring you joy, like seeing friends or family, or finishing a quilt project?
I'm not sure. I haven't... I haven't really seen anyone lately to know. And since I haven't been working on my quilts, I haven't finished anything. So... I don't really know.
Would you say you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like your quilting or gardening, even when you try to do them?

Um... I suppose so. I mean... I used to really love checking on the garden, and working on my own quilt entries. But lately... I don't know. I just look at the fabric... or the seed catalogs... and I just don't feel much of anything at all.
Would you say you’ve been feeling down or hopeless at all, even a little bit, most days lately?
Um... no, I don't think so. I wouldn't say hopeless. I don't really feel... sad, exactly. I just... I don't know.
How long have you been feeling this way, where you don't enjoy things like your quilting or gardening?

Um... probably about nine months. Give or take. It started back when... well, some orders fell behind. And there were some conflicts with the volunteers that kind of blew up. I guess I've just been stuck in this... low, guilty sort of place since then.
Have you noticed that you're doing less overall in your day-to-day life, like moving more slowly or getting less done than usual?

Um... well, my husband mentioned it. He said... I used to pace around the sewing room a lot. Just... sorting the same piles of fabric, over and over. But now... some mornings, I just move so slowly. Even making coffee feels like a chore. So... yes, I suppose I am getting less done.
Have you noticed that your thoughts have been moving more slowly than usual, or that you're physically moving more slowly, like everything feels like it's in slow motion?

Um... I'm not really sure. Like I said, I know I'm moving slower in the mornings. But... my thoughts? I don't think so. I haven't really noticed them being slow, or... feeling like I'm in slow motion.
